(written with the fix; the root cause was confirmed failing in the composed cases)
fixed.how: dependent-branches.ts: closedOnHost asks PrTaskExecutor.reachedBase whether A's reviewed commit is on main. If it is, mergedThrough moves the record to merged with last_outcome merged_through (no migration) and the sentence '#1 was closed, but its change reached main through #2.'. mergedOnHost runs closedReachedThrough for the closed tasks B built on, and fills in B's merge commit. Both read orders and a restart give the same record. A's other merge cards close, and mergedThroughCard files one card with 'Take this work out' and 'Keep it'. pr-answers.ts applies both answers. 'Take this work out' calls TaskTakeOut.takeOut, which now has a through mode: PrTaskExecutor.takeOut with through and throughPlan reverts only A's own commits, from B's merge commit's first parent up to A's reviewed head. task-words.ts mergedDisplay labels the row 'Merged through #2' with the sentence as its detail. Nothing is written to GitHub before the person presses.
fixed.check_in_the_app: Bench with --githost: make a repository project with tasks A and B, where B waits for A, and run them. On the fake GitHub, close A's pull request, then merge B's. Wait one watcher poll (about 60 s). Tasks: A's row reads 'Merged through #<B>'. Inbox: one card '"A" reached main through pull request #<B>' with Take this work out and Keep it. Press Take this work out: one 'Take out: A' pull request opens, and its branch lacks A's file but keeps B's. Restart the daemon: the row and the answered card stay. Live (phase F): the same on forerunner-sandbox, closing A and merging B on github.com before any poll.

fixed.how: closedOnHost calls closeMergeCards(task, url, 'closed'). request-words.ts gives the Answered line 'Closed: #N was closed on GitHub.'. The sweep also closes a card an earlier version left open for a closed record. The watcher now reads each cancelled task's pull request for its state only (cancelledPullRequests: once, and no event fires). fixed.check_in_the_app: Push a commit to an accepted task's branch on the fake GitHub, then press Merge: a 'changed after the review' card appears. fixed.failing_test_before: dependent-branches-merge.test.ts 'l4-github-merge, run L4' > 'L4-github-118: a check that failed ...', 'L4-github-118: a pull request that stopped merging cleanly ...', 'L4-creds-22: Merge pressed right after a push ...'. real-daemon.test.ts 'l4-github-merge, run L4' > first case (press after a push with the lag on) and second case (failed check refused through client.mergePullRequest)
fixed.how: ReviewedPrMerge.headMovedNow is now the press's single read of each pull request in the chain. It reads the branch head (getBranchHead, never only the listing's lagging head), the mergeable state, and the checks on the reviewed head. If the head moved, the PR conflicts, or a check failed, the press is refused at once in the merge step's own sentence, and the record, the row and one card are settled the way the merge step settles them. pull-requests.ts runs it for every task in the chain. Running checks keep 'merges when its checks pass'. The merge PUT stays pinned to the sha. The fake GitHub gains RepoOps.pullHeadLag.
fixed.check_in_the_app: Live (phase F, forerunner-sandbox, the owner's L3-github-3 at person speed): push a commit to an accepted task's branch on github.com and press Merge within a few seconds. The red line '#N changed after the review: ...' shows at once, nothing merges, and one card appears. Make a check fail on an accepted pull request and press Merge: 'A check failed on #N (ci/test): fix it, or merge it on GitHub.' shows at once.

new_problems: The watcher now reads each cancelled task's open pull request once per poll until GitHub says it is closed or merged. That is one more GET per such pull request per poll.

A merged-through record only gets its merge commit once B's merge is read. If Take this work out is pressed before that, it refuses with 'Forerunner is still reading where the change of #A reached main. Try again in a minute.'.
I could not use isScaffoldBranch from l4-github-link's notes for docsTitle, because that branch is not in this base. The merge should apply it in pull-requests.ts docsTitle.
notes_for_other_areas: New exports in loop/merge-mode.ts: MERGED_THROUGH, mergedThroughSentence(pr, through), throughNumberOf(record), isClosedRecord(record).
dependent-branches.ts exports MERGED_THROUGH_OPTIONS and the MergeCardsClosed type. closeMergeCards takes a reason, and cards carry closed: 'merged' | 'closed' | 'merged_through'.
PrTaskExecutor.reachedBase(task, sha) is read-only. takeOut accepts through: true, and throughPlan is exported. TaskTakeOut handles merged_through records.
MergeOutcome.alreadyMerged (ports.ts, append-only). A merge GitHub made first is now recorded as merged_on_host by the merge step too.
CostBucket.tries (api-types.ts, append-only, optional), with taskRunFacts(store, taskIds, period) exported from daemon/views.ts.
daemon/views.ts also exports tasksWentOnLine(kept) and withoutReadyClause(text).
pull-requests.ts exports isJoinedStatusPr(project, pr). join-words.ts settingAppliesLine reads 'the setting of "X"'.
RepoOps.pullHeadLag in the fake GitHub (testenv): the API shows the old pull request head for N reads after a push.
task-words.ts mergedDisplay: a minimal change (the 'Merged through #N' label).
Merge order: l4-github-link touched take-out.ts lines next to mine (the refusal words). Keep both.
